subject: [PATCH 6.12.y 1/2] arm64: sdei: Run the event handler on the kernel vectors

reviews.author: Sasha Levin
reviews.summary: Queued the series for multiple kernel versions without raising any technical concerns or objections.
reviews.raw_body:
> arm64: sdei: Run the event handler on the kernel vectors

Queued the series for 6.12, 6.6, 6.1, 5.15 and 5.10, thanks.

Sasha

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a critical issue in the arm64 SDEI (System Description Event Infrastructure) implementation, where an SDEI event dispatched from user space can cause the CPU to loop indefinitely due to undefined instruction exceptions. The fix involves installing kernel vectors in the __sdei_handler() function when VBAR_EL1 holds trampoline vectors and restoring it before returning to firmware.
